beats.label: 1 · AMBIENCE
beats.text: Beach ambience (assets/sfx/ambience_*.wav if present, otherwise synth).

beats.label: 2 · SILENCE CUT
beats.text: Everything but the drone stops within 2 frames.

beats.label: 3 · DRONE RISING
beats.text: Intensity 0 to 0.6: louder, more harmonics, brighter.

beats.label: 5 · SWEEP UP + SWEEP DOWN
beats.text: Two glissandi at once, a cue before the hit.

beats.label: 6 · IMPACT (HUGE)
beats.text: Broadband hit plus a 42 Hz boom, 3 s decay.

beats.label: 7 · NOISE WALL
beats.text: Thick filtered pink noise for the climax.

beats.label: 8 · DRONE ONLY
beats.text: Everything fades back to the drone.
